pin_note: PLACEHOLDER until the conformance rebase: revision and cache_sha256 are still the cp25 pin (ffbdc2a7, with 8e288666's cache digests). claude/conformance-prep was adapted against GUI.Forms main 96d36969311722531a6a41828b555c2e9fa9261e (package version 0.6) and is built against a local SDK of that commit (CONFORMANCE_PREP.md). The rebase writes the GUI.Forms release that carries the conformance sequence and its 0.6 compiler-cache digests. SwiftEdit builds the GUI.Forms SDK with its own tools/build_sdk.py --features all; the stx packages (stx_rtf2md among them) come from stx at GUI.Forms' stx.lock commit and install into the same prefix. Its tools forward to template_harness, which prepare_dependencies.py checks out at template_harness/ at the commit harness.lock pins; that pin must equal gui_forms/harness.lock.
